content: Progress Chapter 1 We spend the chapter learning about Corliss and the wardens.  She is a hunter, returning her quarry to the town where he will be  tried,  we learn about the wardens while she instructs apprentice  Surin who was sent with her by   Lord Adjudicator Uri Ammital .  After riding and her training Surin, they come to the city of MaidenShield, an ancient city build during the heyday of the Mage Wars where we meet Messenger Nero, a friend of Corliss and a priest , he has a new ward, Marcus, one who rubs Corliss the wrong way and while staying in town she tries to find out about the mysterious man who walked into town one day, finally she is called back to the keep where Uri sends her on an important mission.    Chapter  2 The story starts when Corliss has left we find out about his background,   , until she is called away, just when he begins to relax again, four mysterious people in black show up and try to capture Marcus, mages and he is saved by Maelen, who comes to his rescue and Marcus is forced to flee the town. Nero is hurt by a spellcaster leaving a scar. Marcus is now thought to be a killer and is a fugitive.   Chapter  3 The Rogan Chapter,
